ASTROCARE AI – Intelligent Astronaut Health Monitoring System

ASTROCARE AI is a futuristic, AI-powered astronaut health monitoring platform designed to support astronauts during long-duration space missions. It features an interactive humanoid astronaut interface that allows users to explore different body systems, monitor health indicators, and understand potential health risks.

The software tracks important indicators such as heart rate, blood pressure, body temperature, blood glucose, sleep duration, mood, and physical activity. It analyses health measurements and historical trends to identify unusual changes, provides risk alerts, and offers personalised health improvement recommendations. It also includes mental wellness monitoring, spaceflight hazard awareness, interactive health analytics, and daily wellness challenges.

ASTROCARE AI addresses the challenges of spaceflight by helping astronauts independently assess their physical and mental health, recognise potential problems early, and take appropriate preventive actions. It aims to reduce dependence on immediate medical assistance from Earth and support better health management during missions to the Moon and Mars.

By combining intelligent health analysis, interactive visualisation, and astronaut-centred design, ASTROCARE AI aims to make long-duration human space exploration safer and healthier.
details:
ASTROCARE AI – Intelligent Astronaut Health Monitoring and Decision Support System

1. What does the project do and how does it work?

ASTROCARE AI is an intelligent astronaut health monitoring platform designed to support astronauts during long-duration space missions, including future lunar and Mars explorations.

The application features a futuristic interactive humanoid astronaut that acts as a visual health interface. Astronauts can select different body regions, such as the brain, heart, lungs, bones, muscles, and skin, to explore relevant health information, monitor indicators, and understand potential health risks.

The system collects health information through manual inputs and can be extended to support wearable sensors and medical devices. It monitors important indicators, including heart rate, blood pressure, body temperature, blood glucose, sleep duration, mood, hydration, and physical activity.

The collected information is analysed using health assessment rules and historical trends to identify unusual changes. The application displays health insights, risk alerts, and appropriate preventive recommendations. It also includes mental wellness monitoring, health analytics, and daily wellness activities.

2. What benefits does the project provide?

ASTROCARE AI offers several important benefits:

  • Early health risk identification: Helps astronauts recognise unusual changes in health indicators before they potentially develop into serious problems.
  • Independent health monitoring: Enables astronauts to assess their health without always requiring immediate assistance from Earth.
  • Physical health management: Supports monitoring of cardiovascular health, bone loss, muscle weakness, temperature, and nutrition.
  • Mental wellness support: Helps astronauts track mood, stress, sleep quality, and psychological wellbeing.
  • Clear health visualisation: Uses an interactive humanoid interface, colour-coded indicators, and dynamic charts to make health information easier to understand.
  • Preventive health guidance: Provides educational recommendations and prompts for appropriate health assessments and follow-up.
  • Continuous health tracking: Maintains historical measurements to help identify long-term changes during missions.

3. What is the intended impact of the project?

Our primary goal is to contribute to safer and healthier human space exploration.

During long-duration missions, astronauts face five major human spaceflight hazards: space radiation, isolation and confinement, distance from Earth, altered gravity fields, and hostile closed environments. These hazards can affect different body systems and create physical and psychological challenges.

ASTROCARE AI aims to help astronauts recognise these changes, monitor their health independently, and take appropriate preventive actions.

The project could support future missions to the Moon, Mars, and other deep-space destinations where immediate medical assistance from Earth may be limited or delayed.

Ultimately, we aim to improve astronaut health awareness, support timely medical decision-making, and contribute to the safety and sustainability of future human space exploration.

4. What tools, programming languages, hardware, and software were used?

Our proposed development technology includes:

Frontend development:

  • React.js – Building the interactive user interface.
  • Vite – Application development environment.
  • HTML, CSS, and JavaScript – Application structure, styling, and functionality.
  • Tailwind CSS – Responsive interface design.
  • Framer Motion – Animations and interactive transitions.

Humanoid visualisation:

  • Three.js – Creating interactive 3D astronaut visual
